## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Russel Foundations?
No. 1A, Airforce Station Road, East Tambaram, Chennai 600 059.

### What facilities does Russel Foundations have?
Residential flat promotion, Independent houses, Schools & hospitals, Commercial buildings, Civil works on contract, Architectural modelling, 3D views & walkthroughs, Interior design (Johnson's Signature Spaces), Preconstruction planning, Construction management.

### What sizes are available at Lions Gate?
2 BHK, 3 BHK and penthouse apartments from 1,101 to 1,439 sq ft.

### Is Lions Gate RERA registered?
Yes: TN/01/Building/0070/2023, dated 08/02/2023.

### Do you build for individual owners too?
Yes. We take up civil and allied works on contract, including independent houses, schools, hospitals and commercial buildings.
